meta.title: Dope On Wax
meta.author: Wobble, H0ffman (Logicoma)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Dope On Wax by Logicoma (2019-04-20). Logicoma's 64K intro that won the PC 64K intro competition at Revision 2019, released with WaveSabre's open-sourcing. Music credited to Wobble, H0ffman on Demozoo. 93 BPM, 3:35, 44 tracks, 2891 notes. Instruments: 16 Falcon (FM synth), 7 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 9 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 4 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 21 Scissor, 31 Leveller, 4 Crusher, 9 Echo, 17 Smasher, 3 Chamber, 8 Twister, 18 Cathedral. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.06 dB loudness and at most 0.55 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
